title: Ex 1.4 #10 · {X ∈ 𝒫({1, 2, 3}) : |X| ≤ 1}
prompt: Write $\{X \in \mathscr{P}(\{1, 2, 3\}) : |X| \le 1\}$ by listing its elements between braces.
answer_format: A set of sets between braces, like {∅, {1}, {1, 2}}. Spaces are optional.
hints: X runs over the subsets of {1, 2, 3}.
Keep the subsets with at most one element; ∅ has zero elements.
solution: The subsets of {1, 2, 3} with at most one element are ∅, {1}, {2} and {3}.
